Q6111.reason: The littering ordinance is content-neutral and not aimed at suppressing expression, and it serves an important interest, so it survives the O'Brien test for expressive conduct even though the act was symbolic speech.

Q5735.reason: Only defendants may remove under 28 U.S.C. §1441, so the plaintiff's removal was improper and the whole case will be remanded.

Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause does not disclaim an express warranty or description of the goods (a 1964 model), and warranty liability does not depend on fault, so Carol likely wins.
